Card Q&A.q: After using this card's [When Moving] [On Play] effect to trash a card in my hand, can I choose to not return a card from my trash to the hand?

Effect: [When Moving] [On Play] By trashing 1 card in your hand, you may return 1 Option card with the [Onmyōjutsu] or [Plug-In] trait from your trash to the hand.
Inherited Effect: ＜Barrier＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted in battle, by trashing your top security card, it isn't deleted.)
